Screenshot w3-lp-published.png

c-member-link-preview.2.evidence: GET /jetonomy/v1/link-preview?url=https://wordpress.org/news/ as bob -> 200 {url, original_url, title:'WordPress News', description, image (s.w.org og image), site_name, domain, favicon, type, provider:'generic', ...}.

c-member-link-preview.3.evidence: One topic with a YouTube URL, an X post URL (x.com/jack/status/20) and a wordpress.org post: YouTube renders as the oEmbed player iframe (youtube.com/embed/...), the X post renders as the Twitter embed iframe (550px), the post link as a card. Screenshot w3-lp-three.png

c-member-link-preview.4.evidence: Logged out, the same topics show the same cards: wordpress.org card (title, description, same og image + favicon) and both embeds (YouTube + X iframes) as for bob. Screenshot w3-lp-guest.png

c-member-link-preview.5.evidence: bob GET /link-preview for http://localhost/, http://127.0.0.1/, http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/, http://10.0.0.5/, http://[::1]/, http://192.168.1.1/ and file:///etc/passwd: every one 200 with an empty title, description, image and embed_html, answered in 18-52 ms (no fetch was made). (file:/// comes back with url and domain empty as well, the others echo the url and host.)

c-member-link-preview.6.evidence: http://localtest.me/ (public DNS name resolving to 127.0.0.1) -> 200 empty preview in 312 ms; a public https://httpbin.org/redirect-to?url=http://127.0.0.1/ and ...?url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ -> 200 empty preview. Same empty answer in all cases, no message is exposed.

c-member-link-preview.7.evidence: https://httpbin.org/delay/10 via REST: 200 empty preview after 6.05 s (gives up at the 6 s timeout). Posted through the composer with that URL: POST /spaces/17/posts took ~5.1 s, then the topic page took another ~5.2 s to render the first time; the topic published with a plain link (<a href=...>) and no card. Note: a hanging link stalls publish and the first view by about 5-6 s each (bounded, not indefinite).

c-member-link-preview.8.evidence: https://httpbin.org/status/500: 200 with an empty preview (no PHP error, nothing in debug.log); the second call 10 s later returned in 57 ms vs 865 ms for the first, i.e. the negative cache is used.

c-member-link-preview.9.evidence: Same good URL twice (wordpress.org/news/2026/11/wordpress-7-2-beta-4/): first 1620 ms, second 40 ms with identical data (title 'WordPress 7.2 Beta 4').

c-member-link-preview.10.evidence: bob GET /link-preview through public httpbin.org redirect-to chains ending at example.com: 3, 4 and 5 hops resolve normally (title 'Example Domain', site_name example.com, final url https://example.com/); 6 and 7 hops -> 200 with the empty preview (title '' and site_name '', url left as the requested one), same again on a repeat (negative-cached); debug.log size unchanged (no PHP error). A redirect loop could not be built (no public loop host; localhost is refused by the SSRF guard).

c-member-link-preview.11.evidence: Logged out GET /link-preview?url=http://127.0.0.1/ -> 200 with the same empty preview as for a member, answered in 27 ms (never fetched).

c-member-link-preview.12.evidence: 139-character unbroken URL (utm query) in a topic: link text wraps (overflow-wrap anywhere), card 558px inside the 738px post column, documentElement scrollWidth 1440 (no widening). Screenshot w3-lp-long-1440.png

c-member-link-preview.13.evidence: 390px: card 294px wide inside the column, image scales to 292px, title and description wrap, whole card is the link (367px tall), page scrollWidth 390. Screenshot w3-lp-long-390.png

c-member-link-preview.14.evidence: Reign dark mode: card background rgb(47,49,58), title rgb(229,229,229) = 10.25:1. Screenshot w3-lp-dark-390.png

c-member-link-preview.15.evidence: Link to an Arabic page (aljazeera.net; ar.wikipedia.org returned an empty preview): title and description carry dir=auto and compute direction rtl, also with the site in Arabic (document dir rtl, card start/end gaps equal, no overflow). Screenshots w3-lp-arabic.png, w3-lp-arabic-rtl-site.png. Locale restored to en_US.

c-member-link-preview.16.evidence: Waited out the window, then as a guest (per-IP): hit 1 a real example.com URL (title 'Example Domain'), hits 2-60 distinct URLs -> Cache-Control 'private, max-age=600'; from hit 61 on the answer is the empty preview (200) with Cache-Control: no-store (9 of 9). While limited, the cached example.com URL still returned its full preview with the normal cache header (no limit spent) and a new real URL got the empty preview + no-store. Hits 2-60 used unresolvable *.invalid hosts so the minute was not spent on slow fetches; they are counted before validation, same as real fetches. Concurrent requests undercount (read-modify-write transient), sequential does not.

c-member-link-preview.17.evidence: A standalone wordpress.org post link (https://wordpress.org/news/2026/10/wordpress-7-1-4/) in a topic renders a card with site name 'WORDPRESS NEWS', title 'WordPress 7.1.4', description, og image and date (not just a quote box). Screenshot w3-lp-three.png
